company.name: Lumeris
company.shortDescription: Lumeris is an accountable care delivery innovation company that offers operational support, technology, and consulting services..
company.description: Lumeris is an accountable care delivery innovation company offering health systems, payers, and providers operational support, technology, and consulting services. Its innovative solutions help healthcare organizations design, build, operate, measure, and optimize any accountable care model to accomplish the Triple Aim Plus One: improved quality, cost, and patient and physician satisfaction.

productsAndServices.description: An AI-powered platform that orchestrates primary care workflows, patient engagement, care coordination, and clinical support across payer and care delivery models.
productsAndServices.name: Tom™ Primary Care as a Service Platform

productsAndServices.description: Operational, technology, and clinical support that helps health systems and provider organizations manage risk, improve quality, reduce total cost of care, and perform in value-based contracts.
productsAndServices.name: Value-Based Care Enablement (VBCe)

productsAndServices.description: Hands-on operation, measurement, and optimization of care delivery programs for organizations managing population health and value-based contracts.
productsAndServices.name: Value-Based Care Operations and Managed Services

productsAndServices.description: Healthcare transformation consulting that uses organizational data, operational analysis, and value-based care expertise to identify opportunities for quality improvement, cost reduction, and utilization management.
productsAndServices.name: Strategic Advisory

productsAndServices.description: An AI-enabled, interoperable primary care operating model for rural communities that connects local providers, virtual services, patient data, and care coordination capabilities.
productsAndServices.name: Rural Health Transformation Solution

productsAndServices.description: A cloud-based population health and accountable care platform that integrates healthcare data to support performance measurement, care-gap management, and value-based delivery.
productsAndServices.name: Accountable Delivery System Platform (ADSP)®

items.description: Lumeris and Schmitt-Thompson Clinical Content formed a partnership to integrate STCC’s evidence-based telehealth triage content into the Tom AI-powered Primary Care as a Service platform, enhancing its symptom-checking capability with standardized clinical guidance for patient triage.

sources.title: Lumeris Partners With Schmitt-Thompson Clinical Content to Advance Tom™ Symptom-Checking Capability with Evidence-Based Telehealth Triage Guidance

items.description: Lumeris and Google Cloud continued their collaboration by using Gemini’s native audio capabilities to power the new Native Audio for Tom feature, further aligning their partnership to address the U.S. primary care shortage.

sources.title: Lumeris Introduces Native Audio for Tom, Transforming Real-Time Patient Conversations

items.description: Lumeris and Hackensack Meridian Health expanded their existing value-based care partnership to include Traditional Medicare via an MSSP ACO, leveraging Lumeris technology and HMH’s clinically integrated network to improve outcomes and cost performance for New Jersey Medicare beneficiaries.

sources.title: Collaborative for Healthy Rural America™ (CHRA) Launches to Transform Rural Healthcare Nationwide

items.description: Lumeris and Google Cloud announced a partnership to build and scale Lumeris' Tom platform using Google Cloud's AI and infrastructure, aiming to address the U.S. primary care shortage.

sources.title: Lumeris Partners with Google Cloud to Address the U.S. Primary Care Shortage

insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $133,072,315 to $1,032,905,060, a 7.76x increase.
